title: 第17章 演武场上的斗法第18章 曲师叔的洞府云上峰
slug: 合欢宗从照顾师弟道侣开始修仙
content_zh:
听着外门渐渐远去的脚步声。
卧室中，李蒙站在床边穿好了衣服。
悠哉悠哉的向外走去。
虽然身体有点乏，但今天还有正事要做。
离开卧室的李蒙一头钻进了炼丹室。
筑基丹是二品丹药，不用急着炼制。
随着副职进阶二品，藏宝库中又多了一些二品丹方。
固灵丹，培灵丹，复灵丹，二品养魂丹，筑基丹，真灵丹，解毒丹等等。
二品丹方足有几十个。
奇奇怪怪的丹方不少。
并不全是辅助修炼的丹药。
符箓也多了很多攻击类的符箓。
“起炉！”
沐浴在月光下的小竹峰显得有些寂静。
炼丹房中只听李蒙一声轻呵。
一股炙热的热浪爆发开来。
在丹炉旁，李蒙脸色煞白，气息紊乱。
看着手中的玉瓶，李蒙面露苦笑。
练气修士炼制二品丹药还是过于勉强了。
“没想到自己炼丹也会有法力不足的一天！”

五灵根废体虽然修炼速度慢。
但也有一个好处。
那就是法力远胜于同级的修士。
以前李蒙一身法力能够连续炼制三炉丹药。
但炼制二品丹药一炉都非常勉强。
途中要不是磕了几颗回灵丹。
第一次炼制二品丹药绝对会因法力不足而失败。
年份越久的灵植药力就越狂暴。
需要更多的法力控火炼化。
炼化花费的精力与时间也远超百年灵植。
李蒙起身站了起来，向外走去。
“奇怪，曲师叔今夜怎么没来，难道外出任务了？”
见卧室空空如也，李蒙心中暗道。
倒也没有多想，李蒙盘腿坐在床榻上打坐调息。
第二天，上午。
盘腿坐在床上的李蒙睁开了双眼。
“看来曲师叔果然外出任务了！”
如果曲师叔在宗门内，定不会失约。
李蒙精神饱满的下床离开了卧室，进入了书房。
上午陈师妹要来，炼丹容易被打扰。

符箓虽然讲究的是一气呵成。
但用的时间远低于炼丹。
content_en:
Listening to the footsteps gradually receding from the outer door.
In the bedroom, Li Meng stood beside the bed and got dressed.
He walked out leisurely.
Although I am a little tired, I still have business to do today.
Li Meng left the bedroom and ducked into the alchemy room.
The Foundation Establishment Pill is a second-grade elixir, so there is no need to rush to refine it.
As the deputy position advanced to the second level, there were some more second-level pill recipes in the treasure house.
Strengthening Pill, Spirit-Building Pill, Restoring Spirit Pill, Second-grade Soul-Nourishing Pill, Foundation-Building Pill, True Spirit Pill, Detoxifying Pill, etc.
There are dozens of second-grade elixir prescriptions.
There are many strange prescriptions.
Not all of them are elixirs to assist cultivation.
The talismans also have many more attack talismans.
"Start the stove!"
Xiaozhu Peak, bathed in moonlight, seemed a little quiet.
In the alchemy room, Li Meng only heard a soft chuckle.
A wave of scorching heat erupted.
Next to the alchemy furnace, Li Meng's face was pale and his breath was disordered.
Looking at the jade bottle in his hand, Li Meng smiled bitterly.
The Qi-training monks were still too reluctant to refine the second-grade elixir.
"I didn't expect that one day I would have insufficient mana when making alchemy!"
Although the cultivation speed of the Five Spiritual Root Waste Body is slow.
But there is a benefit.
That is a monk whose magic power is far superior to that of the same level.
In the past, Li Meng could refine three batches of elixirs with his magic power.
But refining a second-grade elixir is very difficult.
If I hadn't taken a few magic pills on the way.
The first time you refine a second-grade elixir, you will definitely fail due to insufficient mana.
The older the spiritual plant is, the more powerful its medicinal power will be.
More mana is needed to control fire and refine.
The energy and time spent on refining also far exceeds that of Breitling Plant.
Li Meng stood up and walked out.
"Strange, why didn't Master Qu come tonight? Is he out on a mission?"
Seeing that the bedroom was empty, Li Meng thought to himself.
Without thinking too much, Li Meng sat cross-legged on the bed and meditated.
The next day, morning.
Li Meng, who was sitting cross-legged on the bed, opened his eyes.
"It seems that Uncle Qu is indeed on a mission!"
If Master Qu is in the sect, he will definitely not break the promise.
Li Meng got out of bed energetically and left the bedroom and entered the study.
Junior Sister Chen is coming in the morning, so the alchemy making will be easily disturbed.
Although the talisman is focused on being completed in one go.
But it takes much less time than refining alchemy.
